title: 豆包手机会泯然众人吗？
content: Nubia’s second-generation Doubao smartphone, slated for release this September, transitions from a direct GUI-operating agent to a hybrid system relying on MCP and A2A protocols. This strategic shift facilitates mass production by aligning with industry standards and reducing dependency on unstable screen scraping. However, it limits functionality to apps that open official APIs. Consequently, the device faces intense competition as competitors adopt similar protocols. Its success now depends on demonstrating superior task management, memory capabilities, and reliable end-to-end execution, distinguishing it from generic AI-powered flagships.

title: 大学学位正在失去其光环
content: University degrees are experiencing a decline in perceived value and prestige. While academic qualifications have traditionally served as reliable indicators of employment prospects and social status, their influence on career outcomes and public perception is waning. This trend reflects broader shifts in labor markets, increased skepticism toward higher education costs, and a growing reliance on alternative skills-based credentials for professional advancement.

title: 阿里又多了一个Agent赛马
content: On September 2, Alibaba launched "Wan You Wu Jie," an enterprise-level platform facilitating collaboration between humans and multiple AI agents. This addition follows a recent consolidation of QoderWork, MuleRun, and Wukong into "Qianwen Office." The strategy reflects Alibaba’s internal competitive approach to enterprise AI, leveraging its diverse assets in models, cloud infrastructure, and organizational tools. While this multi-agent model increases computational demands favorable to Alibaba Cloud, it remains unproven whether enterprises will prioritize these platforms based on tangible business metrics rather than technological novelty.
